punchline: Goleman splits attention into inner, other and outer focus, and says a leader needs all three working together.
thirty_sec: Daniel Goleman says attention points three ways. Inner focus is reading your own gut and values. Other focus is understanding people, and he splits empathy into thinking what they think, feeling what they feel, and wanting to help. Outer focus is seeing a whole system: spotting its patterns and zooming between details and the big picture. A leader who can do all three can assess themselves, listen to a team and decide what to ignore.
